display_title: UI tokens 1/8: replace arbitrary Tailwind sizes that have an exact scale equivalent

issue.title: UI tokens 1/8: replace arbitrary Tailwind sizes that have an exact scale equivalent
issue.body:
## Context

Components carry about 1,400 Tailwind arbitrary values (`src` 1,269, `packages` 134, `apps` 2). Most have an exact equivalent on the scale, so they can be rewritten with no visual change. This is the first of a series that ends with a lint rule and an empty suppression list.

**Prerequisite:** the role lookup in `.agents/skills/react/SKILL.md#role-lookup`, `--text-dense` in `src/app/globals.css`, and `src/styles/roleClassForms.test.ts`. These are on branch `docs/role-class-lookup` (commit `7c9b0dc72`, rebased on `canary` `9e86b68c9`), not on `canary` yet. Start after that branch merges.

## Rewrites (exact equivalents only)

Root font size is fixed at 16px (nothing sets `html { font-size }`), so `N px` equals `N/4` on the spacing scale.

| From | To | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{h,w,size,min-*,max-*,p*,m*,gap*,top,bottom,left,right,inset*,basis,space-*,translate-*,leading}-[Npx]` | `…-{N/4}` | `h-[32px]` → `h-8`, `w-[280px]` → `w-70`, `gap-[6px]` → `gap-1.5`, `gap-[1px]` → `gap-px`. Negative values move the sign: `bottom-[-5px]` → `-bottom-1.25`. |
| `{h,w,size,min-*,max-*}-[100%]` | `…-full` | 102 sites |
| `z-[N]` | `z-N` (`z-[-1]` → `-z-1`) | |
| `ring-[3px]` | `ring-3` | |
| `text-[13px]` | `text-(length:--text-dense)` | 155 sites |
| `rounded-[4px]` / `[6px]` / `[12px]` | `rounded-(--radius-chip)` / `(--radius-input)` / `(--radius-overlay)` | `rounded-[8px]`: pick `--radius-button` or `--radius-card` by what the element is |
| `util-[var(--x)]` | `util-(--x)` | same output, v4 shorthand |

Leave alone: `calc()`, `min()/max()/clamp()`, viewport and `em`/`rem` units, `inherit`, unitless `leading-[1.4]`, grid templates, shadows, and percentages other than 100%.

Off-rhythm values (`gap-[3px]`, `[5px]`, `[7px]`, `[11px]`; about 31 sites) also have exact forms (`gap-0.75`, `gap-1.25`, …). Convert them, and list them in the PR so a reviewer can see which sites sit off the 2/4px rhythm. Do not round them.

Font sizes other than 13px are **not** in this issue; they change line height and are tracked separately.

## Cautions

- Rewrite test files too: some assert class strings.
- Variants and `!` must survive: `md:hover:h-[32px]` → `md:hover:h-8`.
- Do not introduce new utility names. `cn` (554 direct imports, no custom config) misclassifies them; see the lookup notes.

## Expected

- No remaining `-[Npx]` on the utilities above, and no `-[100%]`, in `src`, `packages`, `apps`.
- Proof of equivalence: compile `src/app/globals.css` with `@tailwindcss/postcss` (pattern in `packages/ui/scripts/build-css.mjs`) over the new class names and show each resolves to the original pixel value. No Electron run is needed if that table is attached.
- `bun run check` green.



## Prerequisite PR

Tracked in #699 (`docs/role-class-lookup`, commit `7c9b0dc727d7c26247e4b0b1abf5b65cc1d84164`). Independent light review completed; CI and normal merge remain pending. Start this issue after #699 merges.
